description: Opus JJ JJ-heavy-turn-parity: a Speed-tie mirror, the kind of turn the parity sweeps' extremes runs could not finish. Library balance-ddee (Floette-Eternal + Rillaboom lead) vs library crown-cecil9 (Floette-Eternal + Rillaboom lead): Floette 122 = Floette 122 and Rillaboom 105 = Rillaboom 105, so every Update after every hit and the queue order shuffle a tie. Both Grassy Surges start (tie). Turn 1: both Floettes use Dazzling Gleam (spread), p1 Rillaboom High Horsepower into p2 Floette, p2 Rillaboom Wood Hammer (recoil) into p1 Floette. Fixtures: `.fixed0/.fixed7/.fixed15.json` (every damage roll at index 0, 7, 15; everything else enumerated) against RollMode::Fixed(k).
